crossRefs.note: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

translations.web: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
translations.bsb: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
translations.kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
translations.asv: And the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
